scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist-server/main.js
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --wait db && docker compose run --rm migrate up
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v db && npm run db:up
scripts.storage:up: docker compose up -d --wait garage && sh scripts/garage-init.sh
